description: This file defines the 'Double' type implementing numeric operations, conversions, and comparisons for a custom type system in Go, including protobuf integration.

classes.name: Double
classes.description: A custom float64 type with methods for arithmetic, comparison, conversion, and formatting.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds another ref.Val to this Double.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares this Double with another ref.Val.

methods.name: ConvertToNative
methods.description: Converts this Double to a native Go type based on reflect.Type.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts this Double to a specified ref.Type.

methods.name: Divide
methods.description: Divides this Double by another ref.Val.

methods.name: IsZeroValue
methods.description: Returns true if the Double value is zero.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies this Double by another ref.Val.

methods.name: Subtract
methods.description: Subtracts another ref.Val from this Double.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the Double as a string, handling special float values.
